SOULLINK-RULES.title: Rules
SOULLINK-CARD_MATCHING.title: Card Matching
SOULLINK-CARD_MATCHING.hover.desc: Which of your cards counts as the same card for upgrades, removals and other deck choices: the card at the same position, or the card linked to theirs. The host's setting applies to everyone.
SOULLINK-MODE.title: Mode
SOULLINK-MODE.hover.desc: Nice: whoever can make the same choice has to. Mean: an option is greyed out unless everyone can take it. The host's setting applies to everyone.
SOULLINK-SHARED_DEATH.title: Shared Death
SOULLINK-SHARED_DEATH.hover.desc: Ends the run for everyone when any player dies. The host's setting applies to everyone.
SOULLINK-WHO_DECIDES.title: Who Decides
SOULLINK-WHO_DECIDES.hover.desc: Everyone Agrees: a choice is made once everyone who can make it has clicked it. First Click: the first click makes it for everyone. The host's setting applies to everyone.
